summary.name: wechsel
summary.one_liner: A keyboard-driven macOS utility for connecting and disconnecting Bluetooth audio devices through a Spotlight-style global hotkey window.
use_cases: Switch between Bluetooth headphones or speakers without opening the menu bar
Connect or disconnect a Bluetooth audio device from the keyboard
Quickly toggle Bluetooth audio devices with a global hotkey
Install a Bluetooth utility on macOS via Homebrew
summary.what_it_does: wechsel lets you connect and disconnect Bluetooth audio devices on macOS from the keyboard instead of the built-in Bluetooth menu bar. A global hotkey opens a Spotlight-like window listing devices. You select a device with the arrow keys and press Enter to connect or disconnect it. The project is distributed on GitHub under GPLv3 and can be installed through a Homebrew tap. The page lists version 1.0.2.
notable: Global hotkey opens a Spotlight-like device picker
Arrow keys and Enter to connect or disconnect devices
Open source under GPLv3 with source on GitHub
caveats: Focused on Bluetooth audio devices, not general Bluetooth peripherals
